title: Automation-path translation refuses with a tenant-prefixed lineage: 'is itself a translation of machines-on-machines#<lineage>'
description: Seen 2026-11-16: the automation path refused a source Story as a translation because the lineage id carries the tenant prefix (machines-on-machines#<lineage>) and the translation check compares it against unprefixed ids. Compare after stripping the tenant prefix, or compare through one id helper, then add a Gherkin scenario.
